settings.prompt: Locate every visible adult butterfly or moth, including resting moths with folded wings. Exclude other insects, caterpillars, pupae, and shadows. Use one tight rectangular bounding box per adult butterfly or moth, including all visible wings, body, antennae and legs. Do not infer hidden or cropped parts. Place each edge at the outermost visible point of that individual on that side. Keep any flower, leaf or perch outside the box where possible without clipping the insect. Return only a JSON array, with one object per butterfly: {"bbox_2d": [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], "label": "butterfly"}. Coordinates must be integers from 0 to 1000, normalized independently by the full image width and height. The first pair is the top-left corner; the second is the bottom-right corner. If there are no adult butterflies or moths, return []. Do not include explanations or markdown.
